name: Upper Volta

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of black, white and red; it is identical to the flag of the German Empire.
flag.symbolism: The stripes stood for the three branches of the Volta River that cross the country: the Black, White and Red Volta.

hook: Upper Volta's black, white and red stripes are its three rivers, the Black, White and Red Volta; the German Empire flew exactly the same stripes, and Yemen has them upside down.
trivia: On 4 August 1984, under Thomas Sankara, the country was renamed Burkina Faso, "land of upright people", and given its red and green flag with a yellow star.
The flag is identical to that of the German Empire of 1867–1918, though the two designs have no connection.
